_: What the film service can show (agorzilla-shots/film.mjs): one entry per view of tauhud.com. A brief (yt_brief.py) names scenes by id and adds only its words; nobody invents a page or a selector in a brief. steps: at = seconds into the scene, do = zoom (to a selector; no 'to' = back to the whole page), scroll (to a selector), hover, wait. No step ever clicks a button that sends anything to the chain. sim: true = the view shows our own test ships or bots, and the words spoken over it must say so (yt_brief.check). moment: true = a rule or the chain says no, in view.
